gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Quilon moves with a gentle swell and thinning in its bowls, editorial without shouting. And Noto Sans Meroitic, a plain sans, fills its lines with lowercase that stands nearly as tall as capitals, so Quilon earns its keep big and brief.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-modi: Sharp, editorial, a bit commanding: Quilon has a comfortable stroke contrast that gives every large letter some presence. Noto Sans Modi, a plain sans, keeps daylight inside each curve.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-mono: Quilon looks confident, with mild contrast and tall open shapes. Its strength is that editorial presence, while Noto Sans Mono, a plain sans, offers sturdy, generously spaced letters that never crowd one another.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-mro: Modern and tidy, Noto Sans Mro packs dense, tall middles into its words, while Quilon above it adds medium-range stroke modulation and editorial command. The sans-serif body holds the text steady beneath.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-multani: Quilon's bowls carry a light swell, like pressed glass, and its tall a, e and s stay wide open. Noto Sans Multani, a plain sans, answers with a lofty x-height and a gapped e.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Noto Sans Myanmar lays down a thick, heavy-looking band of text with a broad c. Quilon's strokes thicken and thin in small, gentle steps, and that soft editorial lift against the sturdy sans is what makes the pair work.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Quilon plays thick against thin with the restraint of a worn wooden stamp, editorial and commanding in its tall open forms. Noto Sans Nabataean stands almost cap-tall beneath it, with wide s curves that feel brisk and modern beside it.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Noto Sans Nag Mundari reads contemporary and businesslike, a plain sans whose lowercase rivals its capitals in size. Quilon joins it with quiet stroke modulation and tall open a, e and s, so the headline feels editorial.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Approachable, Noto Sans Nandinagari is a plain sans with big lowercase and short ascenders. Quilon's line weight shifts quietly, like brushed watercolor, so paragraphs below it feel easygoing, openings generous at every weight, and the page never tires.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-newa: Commanding and editorial, Quilon gives its letterforms a medium-key contrast and tall open a, e and s up top. Noto Sans Newa, a sans, handles the text with its clearly open e.
